**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Northwind:

- **§ 12.3** — "Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier... Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 2.1** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," and a decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 13.1** — the access licence is expressly "non-exclusive."
- **§ 12.4** — the only exclusivity-style covenant (Vendor shall not market a directly competing analytics service) binds Brightline in our favour, so we leave it untouched.

Other "exclusive" hits (exclusive remedy, exclusive jurisdiction) are unrelated to sourcing freedom. No redline proposed.
